narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond market expectations. The Iran Parliament threat, US-Israel strike package, and Apache shootdown signal asymmetric escalation, driving equity selloffs and BTC crashes despite diplomatic noise.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures (ES) and long VIX; buy gold and short BTC as hedge against further escalation.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into oil and energy plays as the Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026, per EIA data. The SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals supply pre-positioning, while Kuwait's pipeline bypass talks confirm structural disruption.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs (XLE); short refined product spreads on refinery outage risks.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Mirage vs. Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing a fragile status quo despite White House claims of Iran deal progress, as IDF readiness and Kuwait bypass talks contradict diplomatic optimism. Markets are torn between hope for de-escalation and evidence of ongoing kinetic exchanges.
narratives.trade_implication: Neutral on USD/JPY; buy short-dated T-bills for safety, but avoid long-duration bonds until clarity emerges.
